title: On the strong base locus of a projective variety
summary: We introduce and study the base locus and the strong base locus of a projective variety X. The base locus of X parametrizes configurations of smooth points of X where the span of the tangent spaces of X at these points intersects X at some additional smooth point. The strong base locus parametrizes configurations of smooth points of X for which the span of the tangent spaces of X at the given configuration contains the entire tangent space at an additional point.
